ULTRA-MOIST CHOCOLATE CAKE 🎂 🍫  INGREDIENTS • 200 g flour • 60 g cocoa powder • 200 g sugar • 2 eggs • 180 ml buttermilk • 120 ml oil • 180 ml hot coffee • 1 tsp vanilla • 1 tsp baking soda • 1 tsp baking powder • ½ tsp salt GANACHE • 200 g dark chocolate • 200 ml heavy cream • 30 g butter STEPS 1. Mix dry ingredients. 2. Add eggs, buttermilk, oil and vanilla. 3. Add hot coffee and mix. 4. Bake at 175°C for 30-35 min. Keep the center slightly soft. 5. Heat cream, pour over chocolate, add butter and mix until glossy. 6. Cover the cake generously with ganache. SECRET: Hot coffee intensifies the chocolate flavor, while buttermilk + oil keep the cake incredibly moist. Don't overbake!
